service.description: Retrieves the General Journal (Libro Giornale) data for an organization and fiscal period or date range. Orders transactions chronologically and calculates running totals (Dare/Avere), page splits, and carry-overs.

set.from: {partyId: organizationPartyId, organizationName: org?.organizationName || organizationPartyId, taxIdNumber: orgVatId, socialSecurityNumber: orgFiscalCode, reaNumber: orgRea}

service.description: Locks the General Journal period, permanently assigns sequential journal numbers, and logs the last page and totals in FiscalRegisterLog.

service-call.name: mantle.ledger.FiscalRegisterServices.get#GeneralJournalData
service-call.in-map: {organizationPartyId: organizationPartyId, fiscalYear: fiscalYear, timePeriodId: timePeriodId, fromDate: fromDate, thruDate: thruDate, isFinalizedRun: true}

service-call.name: create#mantle.ledger.report.FiscalRegisterLog
service-call.in-map: {organizationPartyId: organizationPartyId, registerTypeEnumId: 'FregJournal', fiscalYear: fiscalYear, timePeriodId: timePeriodId, fromDate: fromDate, thruDate: thruDate, firstPageNumber: journalData.startPageNumber, lastPageNumber: journalData.endPageNumber, firstSequenceNum: 1, lastSequenceNum: journalData.totalTransactions, totalDebit: journalData.totalDebit, totalCredit: journalData.totalCredit, finalizedDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp, finalizedByUserLoginId: ec.user.userId, isDefinitive: 'Y', comments: comments}

service.description: Retrieves data for Italian VAT Registers (Vendite, Acquisti, Liquidazione Periodica). Computes taxable amounts, tax breakdown by rate/nature, deductible/non-deductible tax, and formatted pagination with running totals.

set.from: {partyId: organizationPartyId, organizationName: org?.organizationName || organizationPartyId, taxIdNumber: orgVatId, socialSecurityNumber: orgFiscalCode, reaNumber: orgRea}

service.description: Posts the periodic VAT settlement (Liquidazione IVA periodica) accounting transaction, closing Output VAT (224000000) and Input VAT Receivable (144000000) against Tax Payable / Erario c/IVA (212300000) for the selected period.
Generates the Italian Periodic VAT Settlement XML (LIPE - Comunicazione Liquidazioni Periodiche IVA) conforming to the Agenzia delle Entrate schema (iv:Fornitura).

Retrieves Withholding Tax details (Ritenute d'Acconto) for independent contractors, freelancers, and commissions. Aggregates data per beneficiary (Percipiente) for Modello 770 and Certificazione Unica (CU), detailing gross fees, non-taxable amounts, taxable base, withheld amounts (RT01/RT02), and F24 payment references (Codice tributo 1040/1038).
